title: SE-CaCTS: a copy-number-aware atlas of lineage- and disease-specific super-enhancers in cancer cell lines
description:
A per-super-enhancer, per-group specificity score (CaCTS for super-enhancers) computed from public H3K27ac ChIP-seq of cancer cell lines, corrected for measured copy number, with a label-permutation false discovery rate.

Release v3.0.1: 2,422 untreated or control experiments on 519 cell lines across 25 Oncotree lineages and 56 primary diseases; 15,324 lineage-specific and 13,950 disease-specific super-enhancers at FDR ≤ 0.10, each a super-enhancer in its own group. Includes the pipeline code and a static dashboard of the results (https://thirtysix.github.io/SE-CaCTS/).

Code is MIT-licensed. Derived data files keep the terms of their sources (see DATA_SOURCES.md); phase2/data/cn_ccle_snp6.hg38.tsv.gz is under ODbL 1.0.
